Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory with detailed site plans and condition assessments including major systems and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 6, 7, 9).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed 10-year enrollment projections with methodology, demographic analysis, capacity utilization by site and grade, and explicit connection to facility actions including new school construction and reconfiguration (Sections 4, 5, 9).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed discussion of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, special education, and CTE; facility projects directly respond to educational goals (Sections 1, 2, 9).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data on outdoor spaces including shade, green surfaces, stormwater management; detailed site-specific greening strategies such as bioswales, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, and climate resilience framing (Section 8).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses climate impacts with detailed environmental and wind analyses, and provides multiple resilience strategies including shade, cool roofs, stormwater management, and HVAC improvements; climate readiness is a theme but not fully district-wide across all sites (Section 8).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Significant detail with district-wide energy use data, strategies for energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, and resilience including solar, battery storage, microgrids, and compliance with Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals (Sections 8, 9).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased prioritization, multiple funding strategies including bonds and state grants, and alignment with district priorities; includes bond issuance scenarios and modernization eligibility (Sections 9, 10).
